visual_qa.identity: Same sculpted wavy ivory hairstyle, gold-edged blindfold and calm visible lower face; normal-size head; narrow waist and slender long limbs; tall navy collar and ivory/navy/gold star-accented ceremonial robe retained.
visual_qa.hard_changes: Two modestly opened ivory chest panels expose a narrow brass spindle with restrained lavender light. Sharpened separated robe panels enlarge silhouette; rear beam has strained offset joints and exactly two unequal-height pans.
visual_qa.anatomy_equipment: Exactly two arms, two legs, delicate hands, two feet, one broad greatsword and two chain-hung scale pans. No extra limbs, giant torso or hollow ring cavity.
visual_qa.framing: 1536x1024 landscape, one full-body character. Hair top approximately y=89; bottommost sword point approximately y=883. Beam tips, both pans, weapon and feet fully enclosed with comfortable margins.
visual_qa.style: Clean polished 2D concept with ivory/navy/brass palette, lavender cel shadows and pale quiet backdrop. No text, inset, source sheet, gore, rust or photorealistic texture.
visual_qa.correction: One targeted framing correction only; entire assembled subject reduced while design identity was preserved.
